title: GSLAD: Prototype-Regularized Graph Structure Learning for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.15483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unsupervised multivariate time series anomaly detection methods typically identify anomalies through forecasting, reconstruction, or representation discrepancies. However, industrial faults may first alter inter-variable structural patterns while individual trajectories remain close to normal, resulting in weak anomaly signals. In this paper, we propose GSLAD, a prototype-regularized graph structure learning framework that uses structural deviations for anomaly scoring. GSLAD adopts a two-phase training strategy. First, a condition-aware graph learner and a graph-based forecaster are optimized with predictive supervision. The inferred normal graphs are then clustered into multiple structural prototypes representing different normal operating regimes, with edge-wise variability characterizing structural uncertainty. translated_title: GSLAD：面向多元时间序列异常检测的原型正则化图结构学习
translated_abstract: 无监督多元时间序列异常检测方法通常通过预测、重构或表征差异来识别异常。然而，工业故障可能首先改变变量间的结构模式，而各变量的轨迹仍接近正常状态，从而导致异常信号微弱。在本文中，我们提出了GSLAD，一个利用结构偏差进行异常评分的原型正则化图结构学习框架。GSLAD采用两阶段训练策略：首先，通过预测监督优化一个条件感知的图学习器和一个基于图的预测器；随后，将推断出的正常图聚类为多个结构原型，以代表不同的正常运行状态，并用边级变异性刻画结构不确定性。在第二阶段，与这些原型的偏差对图学习器进行正则化，促进稳定且与运行状态相匹配的结构学习。
tldr: 提出GSLAD框架，通过原型正则化的图结构学习捕捉变量间结构模式的偏差，有效检测个体轨迹仍正常但结构关系已发生异常变化的多元时间序列工业故障。
en_tdlr: GSLAD is a prototype-regularized graph structure learning framework that scores structural deviations from learned normal-regime prototypes, enabling detection of multivariate time series faults that alter inter-variable patterns before individual trajectories become abnormal.
